content: {"like":["Values high-quality, historically significant opera productions and performers; prefers Met productions and renowned conductors like Levine and Abbado; appreciates strong vocal performances and excellent orchestras; enjoys well-made documentaries and factual films; favors well-produced series and operatic productions such as Rigoletto."],"dislike":["Dislikes productions with poor staging, dark sets, and unattractive costumes; rejects low-quality or gimmicky productions (e.g., Machine Ring, Barenboim Ring); dislikes inferior orchestras and productions compared to the Met; avoids content with poor acting or poor singing; avoids region-locked DVDs and poorly executed productions."]}
